verdict.rationale: INPI's homepage says users can run quick, targeted searches in its databases, which implies public lookup of IP records, but no evidence says those pages show the status of a filing, application, or case. A keyless probe of the data.inpi.fr portal returned HTTP 403, and the probe notes that IP data access requires an account-issued token, so it is unclear how public this lookup is. Missing for 10: documentation that public pages show filing/application/case status, a description of what status fields are shown, and hands-on or independent confirmation that a founder can check status without an account.
